policy.name: Lakshadweep and Andaman & Nicobar Islands Industrial Development Scheme (LANIDS), 2018 - central scheme, last applicable incentive scheme found
policy.order_no: Gazette of India notification (DPIIT/MHA) LANIDS 2018, as amended (registration window extended to 31-03-2022)

other_benefits: Expired LANIDS 2018 (for reference only): capital investment incentive 30% of P&M up to Rs 5 crore; interest incentive 3% on working capital for 5 years; 100% insurance premium; central share of CGST/IGST reimbursed for 5 years; transport and employment incentives (paras 6.1-6.7). Registration closed 31-03-2022; committed liabilities only up to 31-03-2027.

A&N UT Capital Investment Subsidy for MSEs (12th Plan, 2012-17): 25% (South/Middle/North Andaman) and 50% (Nicobar) of fixed investment, ran only to 31-03-2017 (per secondary summaries; the official andssw1.and.nic.in page was unreachable).

Industrial Estate (Allotment & Management) Policy 2025: lease-rent discounts of 50% for the first 15 years in Little Andaman, North & Middle Andaman and Nicobar, and 25% for years 16-25 (Directorate of Industries leaflet). Land benefit only.
Transport subsidy for raw materials and finished goods is listed on industries.andamannicobar.gov.in/IncentivesforIndustries.php without terms or validity.
unverifiable: No current (Oct 2026) UT-level industrial or MSME incentive policy for A&N was found on industries.andamannicobar.gov.in. Its 'Incentives Package' link is a dead '#' link, and the site was last updated 2025-02-12. The older MSME page (andssw1.and.nic.in/industries/msme) returned 503.

The MSME page reportedly says units can get subsidy 'to the maximum tune of Rs 100 lakh on fixed capital investment' (undated, seen only in a search snippet). Its current status could not be confirmed.
RAMP 2026 interventions (e.g. Notification No. 242/2026 for tourism MSMEs) exist but are not manufacturing capital/opex incentives and were not retrieved.
